verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's docs say alerts from monitoring systems are sent with relevant data and grouped into cases, and that alerts can be dispositioned within a case-centric investigation workflow. Subjects appear only indirectly, through CRM objects with associated files. Alert prioritization is never documented. Missing for 10: documented alert prioritization or scoring, explicit grouping of subjects and transactions into a case, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: The Alerts API allows you to send alerts from monitoring systems along with any data that might be relevant for working the alert. Hummingbird will group alerts into cases
Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
Hummingbird allows you to associate files with CRM objects. So, driver's licenses are available wherever that person is being viewed
